definition: The Sun and everything that orbits it: the eight planets, minor planets such as dwarf planets and asteroids, the moons of the planets, and comets.
The clumping together of gas and dust under gravity; in the spinning disc around the young Sun, accretion built up the planets.
An oval-shaped orbit with the body being orbited, such as the Sun, off-centre; the orbiting object moves fastest where it is closest to that body.
